newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ANALOG DEVICES STARTED.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ANALOG DEVICES STARTED.

text.p: Salomon Brothers Inc said Wednesday it began coverage of Analog Devices Inc with a strong buy rating and a 12-month price target of $40 a share.

-- Analyst Erika Klauer said in a research note the strong buy rating was based on improving fundamentals in the standard linear integrated circuit and digital signal processor segments of the semiconductor market.
-- She said her 1997 earnings estimate was $1.05 per share and her 1998 estimate was $1.40 a share.
-- Analog shares were also trading at lower multiples than several of its peers, Klauer said.
